html: Born in Halicarnassus, then under the Persian Empire. His Histories tell how the Greeks and Persians came to war, up to Salamis and after. He travelled widely and wrote down what people told him, so he has been called both the father of history and the father of lies. He spent time in Athens in the age of Pericles.
